name: editorial
description: Thought leadership, narrative, long-form — golden ratio, generous whitespace, minimal decoration

dividers.deco-line-h: height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--color-accent), transparent); opacity: 0.5;
dividers.deco-line-v: width: 2px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--color-accent), transparent); opacity: 0.5;

stripes.deco-stripe-top: position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 2px; background: var(--color-accent);
stripes.deco-stripe-left: position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; bottom: 0; width: 2px; background: var(--color-accent);

orbs.deco-orb-sm: position: absolute; width: 200px; height: 200px; border-radius: 50%; filter: blur(120px); opacity: 0.06;
orbs.deco-orb-lg: position: absolute; width: 400px; height: 400px; border-radius: 50%; filter: blur(120px); opacity: 0.06;
